name: smwgraphics-cake
title: Cake
description:
I've been playing a lot of TSRP2 lately, and one of the levels in it inspired me to make this ExGFX. Included is cake, spikes, and a few decorations for spicing up a level. In my hack, I've had to credit a lot of people, and I know it's a pain in the neck, so I won't make you do it for this.

One last note: There's been a small glitch that I've been unable to fix in the Map16 data. A few objects that should behave like blank tiles behave like water, so if you want to use this, be sure to fix this yourself. Enjoy!
